user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform, with the platform lifting approximately 80-100 mm and supporting a payload of approximately 1 kg.
product_intent: A compact desktop lifting device that enables vertical movement of an internal platform through manual rotation of an external hand crank, while maintaining mechanical stability and safety during operation.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm
The platform should support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

requirements.statement: The product must enable vertical movement of an internal platform through manual rotation of an external hand crank

verification.observable: Platform movement in response to hand crank rotation
verification.condition: Hand crank rotation results in platform vertical displacement

requirements.statement: The internal platform must lift approximately 80-100 mm
The internal platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg

verification.condition: Platform supports specified weight without failure

requirements.statement: The mechanism must be enclosed inside the housing

verification.condition: All mechanical components are contained within housing

requirements.statement: The product must be safe to use

verification.condition: Product meets safety requirements for user operation

requirements.statement: The product must be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Mechanical design complexity and assembly process
verification.condition: Product design allows for feasible manufacturing and assembly

requirements.statement: The product must avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation

verification.observable: Operation stability and lack of jamming during use
verification.condition: No jamming or unstable behavior occurs during normal operation

verification.observable: Product dimensions relative to desktop space
verification.condition: Product fits within typical desktop workspace

requirements.statement: The product must operate manually only

verification.condition: Product operates without external power source

freedoms.subject: Continuous or intermittent lifting operation
freedoms.statement: Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable

freedoms.subject: Use of multiple mechanical components
freedoms.statement: Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

relations.rationale: Platform movement depends on specified lift range
Platform movement must accommodate specified payload

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with manual hand crank
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates external hand crank to raise and lower internal platform within specified range while supporting specified payload

operating_scenarios.name: Safe operation environment
operating_scenarios.description: Product operates in desktop workspace with proper user handling and mechanical stability

assumptions.statement: The specified lift range of 80-100 mm is sufficient for intended application
The specified payload of 1 kg is appropriate for intended application
Manual operation using external hand crank is feasible for specified load and lift range

unknowns.subject: Specific mechanical design parameters for hand crank and platform mechanism

unknowns.reason: The request only specifies 'desktop-sized' without specific dimensions
